I heard about this chemical mescaline pill and since it is very difficult to acquire mescaline especially in Greece I thought to try it out
I took my prescription Zoloft in the morning and had my morning spliff.
In the afternoon I decided to have half a pill and after about an hour decided to take the second half went out. To tell the truth I just felt a bit agitated but I was alright.
Got back to my place with a couple of friends and started smoking some spliff.
I had the bright idea to take a ¼ 2ci from the nose thats when it started I was watching television (here I have to tell you that I am an actor with many plays on my back (tele and theater) I started to have second thoughts about my work and started to think oh my god I can do this this is a lie (something that believe you me I never thought) that single thought became obsessive and compulsive taking huge proportions in my brain.
Even thought my friends tried to calm me down it has been two years now and I still have the same obsessive thought making me paralyze in many occasions.
